# font8x8

Public-domain 8x8 bitmap font by Daniel Hepper, based on public-domain IBM/VGA font data.
The original notice is preserved in `font8x8_basic.h`.

Source: https://github.com/dhepper/font8x8/blob/master/font8x8_basic.h

SHA-256: `49d8df366296b203ca3211bc0672cf2a762135bf12710735b6292756b19dffd5`

Used only by the display/input bring-up screen, not the final CJK UI.
